readings: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. Which media types have an average strictly higher than the simple average of all these per-media-type averages? Show the media type name, its average, and how far it is above that overall average (its average minus the overall average). Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT mt.MediaTypeId,
           mt.Name,
           AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_value
    FROM media_averages
)
SELECT m.Name,
       m.average_bytes_per_millisecond,
       m.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_value AS amount_above_overall_average
FROM media_averages AS m
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE m.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.average_value
